QueryLogJobDefinition SQL connection pool exhaustion — timer job leaks SQL connections each run, pool fills up (max 100) after a few days causing cascading timer job failures. Event 6399: 'Timeout expired. The timeout period elapsed prior to obtaining a connection from the pool'. ULS: QueryLogProcessor AssignDocIdsToResults EndExecuteReader error. Still present after Mar 2026 CU (KB5002843) and Apr 2026 CU (KB5002853). No official fix or KB article published as of Apr 2026. Microsoft confirmed investigating.
issue_index.fix_status: open — last independently confirmed present as of 2026-05 (KB5002843/KB5002853/KB5002863); not re-verified against Jun-Sep 2026 CUs in this update pass, treat as still open
issue_index.workaround: 1) Disable Query Logging Timer Job in Central Admin. 2) Schedule nightly SPTimerV4 restart (pool exhausts in 48-72h). 3) Increase pool size short-term: add Max Pool Size=200 to Search connection string.
